issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וַיִּשָּׂא מַשְׂאֹת מֵאֵת פָּנָיו אֲלֵהֶם' means 'he lifted up portions from before him to them' (i.e., he took portions from his own serving and sent/gave them to his brothers). The Chinese '從他面前拿走供物給他們' says 'took away the offerings from before him and gave them to them,' which reverses the direction: the Hebrew has Joseph giving portions from his own table to the brothers, not taking away offerings from them. This changes who is doing what to whom.
